## Notes

This is a resubmission. The following changes were made in response to the
CRAN review comments:

* The DESCRIPTION file has been revised:
  - acronyms used in the description have been explained;
  - references have been added in the required format with DOI links;
  - the description text has been revised for clarity.

* Console output generated by `cat()` has been made optional by introducing
  a `verbose` argument, allowing users to control whether informative messages
  are displayed.

* Changes in graphical parameters have been revised to ensure that user settings
  are restored after function execution using `on.exit()` immediately after
  saving the original settings.
